The '''GSI-B4 blaster pistol''' was the first [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] produced by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]]. A [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], the GSI-B4 was praised for packing significant firepower into a small and easily-concealed weapon.
